name: Mondo Provinciale Moderno
description:
Everything before the start date happened historically.

Every polity should behave realistically and logically

This specific game also has a map of the moon on a different dimension. Mechanically, that map works the same as the map of the earth. Except each region on that map are the features of the near side of the moon. Because there aren't well-established names for the north pole and south pole highlands areas of the moon, nor are there much for features on the far side of the moon, those entire sections of the moon map are simply named after the whole regions of the north polar region, the south polar highlands region, and the far side of the moon. You must pay attention to the regions on the near side of the moon where polities, should the game enter a state where interaction and region-occupation on the moon is possible, will interact. The regions for the moon are listed separately from the regions on the default, or earth, dimension. As of round one, all moon regions remain unowned.
This means in your simulation you should adhere to the following guidelines:

The regions of "Far Side of the Moon" "Lunar North Polar Region" and "Lunar Southern Highlands" should almost never be occupied or owned by any polity, unless that polity actually did establish occupation over the ENTIRE REGION of the far side of the moon, or the entire North Polar Region, or the entire Lunar Southern Highlands, which is defined as all the land between the 82 degrees south line and the 60 degrees south line, or everything that isn't the key craters and regions around the Lunar South Pole. So if a country simply interacted with one of these 3 massive regions, represent it simply with a well-worded event or a map feature. Do not transfer ownership of the entire region, unless again, the entire region was actually occupied by a polity. All of this is only possible in a game state where logically the polities would be able to even set up "occupation" over lunar regions. Whether by construction or even by army. In a game state where that wouldn't really be possible, there is no need to transfer ownership of any regions. This rule also adjusts for difficulty of course, so impossible should have a harder time doing any of the above, normal mode having a realistic level of difficulty, and very easy being able to do anything at anytime.
base_prompt: Il mondo contemporaneo del 2024. Un'epoca segnata dalla globalizzazione, dall'economia digitale e da nuove sfide alla sicurezza. Gli USA restano l'unica superpotenza, ma la Cina cresce rapidamente. La Russia ha riaffermato la sua influenza nello spazio post-sovietico. L'Unione Europea cerca un ruolo più incisivo. NATO e UE si sono ampliate verso est. Il Medio Oriente vive instabilità regionale. L'Africa mostra una rapida crescita economica. L'Asia è diventata il centro dell'economia mondiale. Ogni nazione conserva le proprie reali caratteristiche geografiche, economiche e culturali. Sono possibili tutti gli svolgimenti storici alternativi.
